explicit_assumptions_and_limits: Generic codec results require an explicit RoundTrip premise. The concrete SampleRecord codec is a binary illustration, not RFC8785 JSON canonicalization.
Implementation agreement requires conformance to the same specification; the runtime implementations are not proved conformant by these lemmas.
Refinement and safety transfer require supplied initial/step preservation and abstract safety premises. The concrete refinement example is an integer counter, not an operational NCPS system.
Closure and acceptance rules operate on modeled status flags; a pass flag is not independently established evidence that external schema, Ed25519, authority, freshness or deployments passed.
UTF8 boundary uses Lean String.fromUTF8? and rejects a BOM; Unicode scalar examples do not establish a complete JSON parser, escaping policy or JCS canonicalizer.
Only foundational logical axioms propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice occur. Their disclosed presence is separate from theorem hypotheses and the model-to-implementation gap.
